nodes.name: Phasor
nodes.pitch: The Pleroma stores items in one fixed array and answers key, flag, order and time questions exactly, refusing past capacity. Under it, a phasor codec for bind, bundle and unbind.

nodes.name: EvalApp
nodes.pitch: Resource-gated concurrency that tunes itself, sagas with compensation, middleware and a fluent builder. The execution engine under the other libraries.

nodes.name: HoloDb
nodes.pitch: Answers exact, similarity and aggregate queries from one store, with transactions, a larger-than-memory paged engine, and a networked client.

nodes.name: AlgFormer
nodes.pitch: Two interchangeable attention cores, classic softmax and holographic, in pure managed code, with optional GPU acceleration.

nodes.name: Prism
nodes.pitch: The package behind the Prism tool: a confidence-gated decode policy, an append-only lineage journal and growth tools for AlgFormer models.

nodes.name: Prose
nodes.pitch: Mines real text with deterministic grammar rules into a HoloDb database, then recombines it into new sentences and question and answer pairs.

nodes.name: Tracer
nodes.pitch: Navmesh pathfinding for crowds: swarms that share goals, dynamic obstacles, line of sight and combat, tuned to your frame budget.

nodes.name: HoloVoxel
nodes.pitch: Level of detail is a property of the read: near data stays crisp and far data degrades gracefully, with SIMD throughout.
